properties.description: The local gate runner. Executes exactly what ci.yml runs, in its order, reading the list through skill_lint's ci_gates() rather than restating it. Standard library only, deliberately: pyyaml is not in the base image, which is why skill_lint's parser is a text scan and why reusing it is the right call rather than writing a second one. Refuses to report a pass on zero gates, refuses a near-empty parse as broken, and returns the failure in the exit code. Nothing is piped through head.
properties.name: run_ci_gates.py
